name: SportsGameOdds
description: Sports events, bookmaker odds, teams, players and market metadata. API key required. Free Amateur plan: 2,500 returned objects/month, 10 requests/minute and 10-minute updates; books, leagues and markets depend on plan. Keep response pagination and event status alongside odds. Read-only REST tools; no streaming or wagering. Docs: https://sportsgameodds.com/docs/

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API key
credential_fields.description: Personal API key from the provider account. Endpoint access depends on the subscribed plan.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: List sports supported by the API.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: List supported leagues, optionally filtered by sport.

sportID.description: The sport to get leagues for

leagueID.description: The league to get data for

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Get events with odds/results and a nextCursor when available. Use eventID or league/date filters; every returned event consumes an object.

eventID.description: An eventID to get Event data for

eventIDs.description: A comma separated list of eventIDs to get Event data for

sportID.description: A sportID or comma-separated list of sportIDs to get Events for

leagueID.description: A leagueID or comma-separated list of leagueIDs to get Events for

type.description: Only include Events of the specified type

oddsAvailable.description: Whether you want only Events which do (true) or do not (false) have odds markets which are currently available (open for wagering)

oddsPresent.description: Whether you want only Events which do (true) or do not (false) have any associated odds markets regardless of whether those odds markets are currently available (open for wagering)

oddID.description: An oddID or comma-separated list of oddIDs to include odds for

includeOpposingOdds.description: Whether to include opposing odds for each included oddID

includeAltLines.description: Whether to include alternate lines in the odds byBookmaker data

expandResults.description: Whether to expand the results object to include all stat values rather than just the base set

includeOpenCloseOdds.description: Whether to include open and close odds values (openOdds, closeOdds, openSpread, closeSpread, openOverUnder, closeOverUnder) in the odds byBookmaker data

bookmakerID.description: A bookmakerID or comma-separated list of bookmakerIDs to include odds for

teamID.description: A teamID or comma-separated list of teamIDs to include Events for

playerID.description: A playerID or comma-separated list of playerIDs to include Events (and associated odds) for

finalized.description: Only include finalized Events (true), exclude unfinalized Events (false) or all Events (omit)

live.description: Only include live Events (true), only non-live Events (false) or all Events (omit)

started.description: Only include Events which have have previously started (true), only Events which have not previously started (false) or all Events (omit)

ended.description: Only include Events which have have ended (true), only Events which have not ended (false) or all Events (omit)

cancelled.description: Only include cancelled Events (true), only non-cancelled Events (false) or all Events (omit)

startsAfter.description: Get Events that start after this date

startsBefore.description: Get Events that start before this date

limit.description: The maximum number of Events to return

cursor.description: The cursor for the request. Used to get the next group of Events. This is an opaque token — pass the nextCursor value from the prior response unchanged.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Get team metadata with cursor pagination.

sportID.description: A single sportID or comma-separated list of sportIDs to get Teams for

leagueID.description: A single leagueID or comma-separated list of leagueIDs to get Teams for

teamID.description: A single teamID or comma-separated list of teamIDs to get data for

limit.description: The maximum number of Teams to return

cursor.description: The cursor for the request. Used to get the next group of Teams. This is an opaque token — pass the nextCursor value from the prior response unchanged.

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: Get player metadata with cursor pagination.

teamID.description: TeamID to get Players data for

eventID.description: EventID to get Players data for

limit.description: The maximum number of Players to return

cursor.description: The cursor for the request. Used to get the next group of Players. This is an opaque token — pass the nextCursor value from the prior response unchanged.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Discover market identifiers and their periods, bet types and statistics.

oddID.description: A single oddID or comma-separated list of oddIDs. Used to specify specific Markets to return.

sportID.description: A single sportID or comma-separated list of sportIDs to filter Markets by

leagueID.description: A single leagueID or comma-separated list of leagueIDs to filter Markets by

bookmakerID.description: A single bookmakerID or comma-separated list of bookmakerIDs to filter Markets by

statID.description: A single statID or comma-separated list of statIDs to filter Markets by

statEntityID.description: A single statEntityID or comma-separated list of statEntityIDs to filter Markets by

periodID.description: A single periodID or comma-separated list of periodIDs to filter Markets by

betTypeID.description: A single betTypeID or comma-separated list of betTypeIDs to filter Markets by

sideID.description: A single sideID or comma-separated list of sideIDs to filter Markets by

isMainMarket.description: Filter to only include main markets (main period moneyline, spread, and over/under)

isProp.description: Filter by whether it is any type of prop bet market

isSubPeriod.description: Filter by whether it tracks a sub/non-main period

propType.description: Filter by prop type (game_prop, team_prop, player_prop, other_prop)

isSupported.description: Filter whether this market is fully supported by at least 1 bookmaker in at least 1 league. Defaults to true if not specified.

limit.description: The maximum number of Markets to return (default: 100, max: 10000)

cursor.description: The cursor for pagination. Use nextCursor from prior response.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get account quotas and current usage.
